keyEvents.text: Goal! Toluca 1, Monterrey 0. Nicolás Castro (Toluca) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Brian García.
Goal! Toluca 2, Monterrey 0. Paulinho (Toluca) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Nicolás Castro with a through ball.
First Half ends, Toluca 2, Monterrey 0.
César Garza (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Toluca 3, Monterrey 0. Paulinho (Toluca) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Helinho.
Lucas Ocampos (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card.
Helinho (Toluca) is shown the yellow card.
Orbelín Pineda (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Monterrey. Iker Fimbres replaces Hugo Cuypers.
Substitution, Monterrey. Aldo de Nigris replaces Ricardo Chávez.
Substitution, Monterrey. Érick Aguirre replaces Orbelín Pineda.
Óliver Torres (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Carlos Salcedo (Monterrey) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Substitution, Monterrey. Fidel Ambríz replaces Lucas Ocampos.
Substitution, Monterrey. Stefan Medina replaces Óliver Torres.
Substitution, Toluca. Jesús Angulo replaces Alexis Vega.
Substitution, Toluca. Federico Viñas replaces Helinho.
Delay in match because of an injury Fidel Ambríz (Monterrey).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Fidel Ambríz (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Toluca. Fernando Arce replaces Franco Romero.
Substitution, Toluca. Víctor Guzmán replaces Érick Gutiérrez.
